plan.thesis: A tall limestone-and-bronze waterfront salon forms the estate’s civic heart: an elevated, deeply shaded living pavilion with a single calm roofline facing the sea. Lower timber-lined suite bars engage its flanks as quiet inhabited buttresses, while a low arrival porch and a broad seaward terrace make the journey from landward arrival to water deliberately legible.
